description: Minimal capability set: the frontend may call the app's own commands and open a native file picker. No filesystem, shell or network permissions are granted. Phase 14 is the first feature that makes the WebView read a file at all — a video element cannot be fed over the RPC channel — and it reads only through the asset protocol, whose scope is empty in tauri.conf.json. The scope is extended one file at a time, and only by `commands::choose_clip`, which opens its own dialog in Rust and admits exactly what came back. What keeps that narrow is not who opened the picker: it is that there is no command anywhere taking a path and granting access to it, so the frontend cannot name a file it wants read. Permissions are added as features need them, not in advance.
